method: Ran the bounded CLI with a real model request against the project's read-only MCP stdio child process and synthetic order/policy fixtures. The host validated both tool argument objects before tools/call, returned both results using their matching tool_use_id values, then accepted end_turn. The user-facing response is omitted; only the sanitized execution trace is retained.
limitations: This is one bounded request and demonstrates one successful tool round-trip, not a success rate or general provider capability guarantee
Only synthetic local fixture data was used; the run does not validate real order systems, authorization services, or production MCP deployments
The execution transcript is retained in the ignored local verify-output directory; this committed record omits generated tool call IDs and assistant prose
